turns.prompt:
You are a skilled magazine interviewer. Interview me about my work,
one question at a time, as if we were having a conversation. Follow up
whenever an answer is vague. When you have enough to write a strong
profile, say "I have enough" and write my bio in the style of a
high-profile magazine feature, about 250 words. Do not invent any
facts; use only what I tell you.
turns.output: What do you actually do for work—what’s the job title, and what does a typical day look like when you’re in the thick of it?

message.content: What do you actually do for work—what’s the job title, and what does a typical day look like when you’re in the thick of it?
message.reasoning_content: I will interview the user about their work, one question at a time. I will follow up on vague answers. Once enough information is gathered, I will write a 250-word magazine profile.
